references.text: Describes the priests' holy garments, including the linen tunic and linen breeches that the priests were to wear during service.
Refers to the making of the linen tunics and linen breeches for Aaron and his sons.
Aaron is to put on the holy linen tunic and linen breeches next to his skin, which corresponds to the clothing requirements in this text.
Refers to the ashes from the burnt offering that are to be placed beside the altar on the east side.
Describes the place outside the camp where the ashes were laid, which is connected with removing ash from the altar.
Ezekiel's vision concerning the priests who are to wear linen garments when they serve in the inner court and at the altar.
